history.summary: A compact 1BR at PLQ / Park Place Residences (Lendlease, 2019) — 310m to the Paya Lebar interchange and integrated with the PLQ mall/offices, in the Paya Lebar Central growth zone. Strong location and rental story at a sane $1.09M entry; held back only by 1BR niche-ness and a moderate 3.15%/yr rate.
history.rating_rationale: Best-in-class connectivity: 310m (4 min) to EW8/CC9 Paya Lebar dual-line interchange, integrated with PLQ retail and Grade-A offices. Paya Lebar Central + the airbase relocation is one of Singapore's strongest govt transformation catalysts. score 620, on_frontier=true, deep 104-txn base. URA 3.15%/yr is decent for leasehold. At $1.088M / $2,248 PSF the entry is liquid. 1BR shallow pool and leasehold decay are the main caveats but the integrated-MRT location offsets exit risk.
red_flags: resale-only rate not isolated (3.15% is blended)
catalysts: 310m to Paya Lebar EW8/CC9 interchange, integrated with PLQ mall + offices
Paya Lebar Central growth zone + airbase relocation land release

history.summary: A 484 sqft 1BR asking $1,188,000 / $2,455 psf — roughly 9-12% above its own size-cohort verified prints (2025-26: $1.06M-$1.11M, $2,188-$2,291 psf; latest Apr 2026 $1.06M/$2,188) and above all competing 484-sqft asks ($1.10M-$1.16M), at the exact top of the project 12-month psf band (avg $2,257). The prior 2026-06-08 Buy was at $1.09M, i.e. at-band; this ask is the same product ~9% dearer. Under v3.4-v3.6 priors the only validated forward signal (cheap-vs-same-size-peers) reads negative, the interchange/PLQ-integration premium is priced in (level effect, not a forward edge), and Paya Lebar Central transformation carries no measured forward power.
history.rating_rationale: Asking ~9-12% above verified same-size comps — expensive-vs-peers is the inverse of the one robust forward signal; connectivity premium is in the price; gross yield 3.5-4.1% at $1.19M is unexceptional; project momentum negative (-0.233), blended appreciation 2.76%/yr; algo 404 below threshold. Would re-rate near $1.06M-$1.10M (at-band).
red_flags: Asking $2,455 psf vs 484-sqft cohort prints $2,188-$2,291 (2025-26) — ~9-12% premium to verified comps
At the top of the 12-month project psf band (max $2,454, avg $2,257)
Negative project momentum (-0.233); blended appreciation only 2.76%/yr
99-yr leasehold from 2015 — lease decay over hold
catalysts: 310m to Paya Lebar EW8/CC9 interchange + PLQ mall/office integration (priced in — supports rentability, not forward edge)
Deep 100+ txn liquidity and solid 1BR rental demand ($3,500-$4,100/mo)
history.source: re-eval under v3.4.1+ priors (2026-06-11 loop iter 15; supersedes 2026-06-08 pre-prior-fix Buy)
